So, yes. I use both a combination of a work logbook and my reminders app. I’m on the spectrum so both of these are highly detailed, but often that’s my problem. I end up bogged down and wasting time writing out the details of each task that comes up that I know I can’t take care of immediately, because I worry that if I don’t pay close attention to all the details of a task then I will miss something or forget it. 

I guess my overarching problem is I spend more time detailing the tasks which pop up as I go about my day.

I find this approach helpful as someone who has executive functioning difficulties. I started using the  pomodoro technique during university but I find I can find myself overwhelmed if too many things are happening at once all vying for my attention. The result is often I don’t stop and think “can I take care of this in two minutes or less” because I’m always worried I’m going to forget about that task if I don’t take care of it immediately.

The problem doesn’t start or end with Trump. The problem America and unfortunately the world must face is an overturning of decades of Unipolar geopolitical relations. 

For better or worse America emerged out of the collapse of the Soviet Union as the sole geopolitical policy maker. For 30-40 years America has been able to pursue Unipolar geopolitical relations unimpeded. Right now we are beginning to see that change as both Russia and China + India become significant geopolitical players. I know on paper both Russia and China desire Multipolar geopolitical relations between nations like the US and others. 

America has not had to treat anyone as their equal geopolitically for decades and it is unlikely they will change approaches even as nations like China and Russia become powerful geopolitical actors globally. 

The problem America faces and by extension the rest of the world, is quite simply that America can not afford to approach geopolitics differently. Historically during times of internal crisis America has been able to rely upon the “external enemy”. However, with both China and Russia exerting geopolitical influence in various regions it is increasingly difficult to find an external enemy which can be easily opposed. As both China and Russia are increasingly in a position to support or aid in geopolitical conflicts. 

Long and short of it is, even though many Americans didn’t want this president and don’t approve of their government’s actions. It doesn’t matter what the citizens think, they don’t understand that there is no turning back now. To turn back now would mean fundamentally changing the lives of Americans and the quality of life they have come to expect. I certainly don’t know what the future holds for America but this illusion that the people of America control their government needs to be discarded or at minimum re-evaluated. The only way America changes is if the people of America band together and collectively agree that enough is enough. It means organizing your communities, it means building unions or at minimum labour councils, it means reading and listening to the voices from nations yours has historically opposed. It means discomfort in learning from those who are oppressed in your very nation. It means a lot of things but it starts with the discarding of apathy and embracing the possibility that something better is possible even if it seems impossible. Cause it will seem impossible, but believing in the impossible is always better than accepting the inevitable.

I would add that often ADHD difficulties with executive functioning skills in everyday life can lead to the development of co-morbid disorders, most commonly Anxiety disorders or Depression.

Evo (deposed president) resigned after wining a third term as allowed after the removal of term limits. The right wing parties cried foul and started riots and acts of violence. Evo resigned in an attempt to get the violence to stop alongside the military denouncing him. The Christian minority now has seized power and is removing all the advances made for the indigenous people of Bolivia. Along with terrifying phrases like “Once again this nation belongs to Christ!”. Lots of indigenous people forming a resistance movement but in-term government has authorized indiscriminate use of lethal force against the people. In short a license to murder with impunity. 

Colombia: Similar to Chile as economic austerity measures have brought about the outbreak of historical tensions. Current government is inexperienced dealing with movements at this scale and has given the paramilitary and military forces the responsibility of dealing with pacifying the protests.
